name: Mind
description: Pet can think, converse, and remember

features.description: SQLite database with migrations and connection management for conversations, memory, and settings
steps: Add rusqlite dependency to Cargo.toml
Create src-tauri/src/db/mod.rs with connection management
Create src-tauri/src/db/migrations.rs with schema for conversations, messages, memory, and settings tables
Create src-tauri/src/db/models.rs with data models (Message, Conversation, Memory)
Write unit test: open in-memory database, run migrations, verify tables exist
Write unit test: insert and retrieve a conversation with messages
Write unit test: insert and query memory by key

features.description: LLM provider abstraction layer with config types and error handling
steps: Create src-tauri/src/agent/mod.rs with module structure
Create src-tauri/src/agent/core.rs with provider trait and config types
Define LlmProvider trait with send_message and stream_message methods
Define ProviderConfig enum (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama) with API key, model, base URL fields
Define AgentError type for provider failures
Write unit test: ProviderConfig deserialization from JSON
Write unit test: AgentError display and from implementations

features.description: System prompt builder with personality traits, pet state, and time context
steps: Create src-tauri/src/agent/prompt.rs with SystemPromptBuilder
Define PersonalityTraits struct (cheerfulness, curiosity, mischievousness, clinginess)
Build dynamic system prompt including personality, mood, needs, time of day, recent memories
Write unit test: prompt includes personality trait values
Write unit test: prompt includes current time context
Write unit test: prompt includes mood label and needs percentages

features.description: Agent tool definitions (move_to, change_state, speak, remember, recall, show_emotion)
steps: Create src-tauri/src/agent/tools.rs with tool definitions
Define each tool as a struct with typed parameters and description
Implement tool execution dispatch (match on tool name, validate params)
Write unit test: each tool has correct name and parameter schema
Write unit test: tool dispatch routes to correct handler
Write unit test: invalid tool name returns appropriate error

features.description: Chat UI with text input bubble for conversation
steps: Create src/ui/chat-bubble.ts with chat input and message display
Add chat bubble HTML/CSS overlay that appears when pet is clicked or chat is triggered
Text input field with send button for user messages
Message list showing user and pet messages with timestamps
Chat bubble positioned near the pet, semi-transparent background
Use Playwright to verify chat bubble appears, accepts input, and displays messages

features.description: Streaming response display — chat text appears token by token
steps: Implement streaming response handler in chat-bubble.ts
Display tokens incrementally as they arrive from the LLM
Show typing indicator while waiting for first token
Smooth animation for text appearance
Manual verification: chat text streams in token by token, not all at once

features.description: LLM connection via OpenAI provider — sends message, receives response
steps: Add rig-core dependency to Cargo.toml
Implement OpenAI provider using rig-core's OpenAI integration
Create Tauri IPC command for sending chat messages
Write integration test (mocked): construct OpenAI provider, send message, verify response parsing
Write integration test (mocked): handle API error gracefully
Register chat IPC commands in lib.rs

features.description: LLM connection via Anthropic provider — sends message, receives response
steps: Implement Anthropic provider using rig-core's Anthropic integration
Write integration test (mocked): construct Anthropic provider, send message, verify response parsing
Write integration test (mocked): handle API error gracefully

features.description: LLM connection via Ollama provider — sends message, receives response
steps: Implement Ollama provider using rig-core's Ollama integration
Write integration test (mocked): construct Ollama provider with localhost URL, send message, verify response
Write integration test (mocked): handle connection refused gracefully

features.description: Tool calling — agent can invoke move_to and other tools to control pet
steps: Wire tool definitions to rig-core agent builder
Implement tool execution that bridges to frontend via Tauri IPC events
Write integration test (mocked): agent response contains tool call, tool is executed
Write integration test (mocked): move_to tool changes pet position
Write integration test (mocked): change_state tool changes pet animation

features.description: Conversation persistence — messages saved to SQLite, reloadable after restart
steps: Save user messages and agent responses to SQLite on each exchange
Load recent conversation history on app startup
Write integration test: send 5 messages, restart (reopen DB), verify all 5 reload
Write integration test: conversation with tool calls is saved correctly

features.description: Memory recall — pet remembers facts across conversations
steps: Create src-tauri/src/agent/memory.rs with short-term and long-term memory
Short-term: sliding window of last 20 messages in current conversation
Long-term: key-value memory store in SQLite with timestamps
Integrate remember/recall tools with memory system
Write integration test: store fact 'user name is Alice', recall it in next conversation
Write integration test: short-term memory limited to 20 messages

features.description: Fallback chain — cloud → local → rules provider priority with graceful degradation
steps: Implement provider chain: try primary provider, on failure try fallback, on failure use rules
Rule-based fallback: predefined responses for common inputs (greetings, simple questions)
Write integration test: primary fails → fallback succeeds
Write integration test: all LLM providers fail → rule-based response returned
Write integration test: fallback does not add excessive latency

features.description: Rate limiting — no more than 1 proactive LLM call per 30 seconds
steps: Implement rate limiter for proactive (non-user-initiated) LLM calls
Track last proactive call timestamp, enforce 30-second minimum interval
No rate limit on user-initiated conversation
Write integration test: rapid proactive calls are throttled to 1 per 30s
Write integration test: user-initiated calls bypass rate limit

features.description: Persona consistency — responses match configured personality traits
steps: Create src-tauri/src/agent/personality.rs with personality trait engine
Personality traits influence system prompt tone and behavior rules
Traits shift slightly based on interaction patterns over time
Manual verification: set high cheerfulness + curiosity, verify responses are upbeat and inquisitive
Manual verification: set low cheerfulness + high clinginess, verify responses are needy and subdued
